entries.prompt:
Task: The TextEdit document notes-fix.txt has a typo: "Tuesdya" should be "Tuesday". Fix it, keep everything else exactly the same, and save the document.

Actions:
fill({"ref": "First Text View", "text": "Meeting at 3pm on Tuesday.\nBring the slides."}) -> ok
menu({"menu": "文件", "item": "保存"}) -> error: menu command 文件 > 保存 is disabled (the app is in the background; its menus only work after desktop_activate)
activate({}) -> ok
menu({"menu": "文件", "item": "保存"}) -> ok
done({}) -> task ended

Checker: expected "Meeting at 3pm on Tuesday.\nBring the slides.\n", found {"disk": "Meeting at 3pm on Tuesday.\nBring the slides."}
entries.lesson: Before editing a document's text, read its full current contents and preserve every character, including trailing whitespace and line breaks; never retype the content from memory.

press({"ref": "Five"}) -> ok
press({"ref": "Add"}) -> ok
press({"ref": "Two"}) -> ok
press({"ref": "Seven"}) -> ok
press({"ref": "Multiply"}) -> ok
press({"ref": "Three"}) -> ok

done({}) -> task ended

Checker: expected "126", found {"display": "96", "previous_expression": "15 + 27 × 3", "computed": true}
entries.lesson: When an expression mixes addition and multiplication, press Equals after the addition to resolve that part before entering the multiplication, or otherwise ensure the grouping you intend is actually applied.
